note: Tunes step 3: three Hard tunes by ear, one that dips under Do, one with leaps of a 4th (guessed from the staff, then checked), one from the high Do down to the Sol under Do, learned in the named stages. Key and tempo are moves (60 up to 90) in place of the old Key selector and the key named in the text, with a {{?key}} line.

exercise.title: Tunes that leap and dip under Do
exercise.why: A tune stays in your ear as a shape around Do, so once you know where it leaps and where it goes under Do you can sing it from any starting note.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. It starts on the Sol under Do, climbs by step past Do, and goes under Do again before it ends. Listen once, then sing along on "la".
Practice until the notes under Do land without a slide.
{{?key}}In another key Do moves, and the tune still starts on the Sol under it.

This tune has three leaps of a 4th: Do up to Fa, Sol down to Re, and Re up to Sol. Look at the staff below and guess how it goes. Then press Play below to check your guess, and sing along on "la".
If a leap lands off the note, sing only its two notes slowly, then put them back in the tune.

Press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. It starts on the high Do, comes down by skips to Do, and dips to the Sol under Do before it ends. Sing along on "oo", which keeps the high start light.
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once you hear each next note before you sing it, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.
